description_en: Queries the service invocation records of a specified device
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定设备的服务调用记录
name: QueryDeviceServiceData

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数。数量限制：每页最多可显示50条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备所属的产品ProductKey。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name that you want to query.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备名称。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en: The start time of the service invocation records to query. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds. Example: 1579249499000
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的服务调用记录的开始时间。取值为毫秒值时间戳，例如：1579249499000
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the service to query. You can view the service Identifier in the feature definition of the product to which the device belongs in the console, or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html.

If the service is testService under a custom (non-default) module testFb, set this parameter to testFb:testService.

If you do not specify this parameter, all service data under the default module and custom modules is queried
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的服务标识符。设备的服务Identifier。可在控制台中，设备所属的产品的功能定义中查看；或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html。

如果是自定义（非默认）模块testFb下服务testService，则参数值为testFb:testService。

不传入此参数时，查询默认模块和自定义模块下的所有服务数据
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order of service invocation records by time in the response. Valid values:

0: in reverse chronological order.
1: in chronological order
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果中，服务调用记录按时间排序的方式。取值：

0：倒序。
1：正序
parameters.name: asc

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device that you want to query. The ID is issued by IoT Platform and is the unique identifier of the device.
<notice> IotId is the unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。
<notice> IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The end time of the service invocation records to query. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds. Example: 1579249499000
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的服务调用记录的结束时间。取值为毫秒值时间戳，例如：1579249499000
parameters.name: end_time

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The service invocation records returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的设备服务调用记录

NextTime.description_en:
The start time of the service invocation records on the next page.
You can use this value as the StartTime in the next request to query the next page of service invocation records
NextTime.description_zh:
下一页面中的服务调用记录的起始时间。
调用本接口查询下一页服务调用记录时，该值可作为请求StartTime的值

NextValid.description_en:
Indicates whether the next page of service invocation records exists.
true: The next page exists.
false: The next page does not exist.

If NextValid is true, you can use the value of NextTime as the StartTime in the next request to query the remaining data
NextValid.description_zh:
是否有下一页服务调用记录。
true：有。
false：没有。

返回NextValid为true时，可以将NextTime的值作为下次查询的StartTime，继续查询本次查询不显示的数据

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
